roles.GOVERNING: durable normative meaning that can constrain project decisions, authority, obligations, policy, architecture or procedure
roles.EVIDENCE: observation, qualification, analysis or result supporting a claim/decision without itself becoming normative merely by existence
roles.CONTROL: current operational/workflow/machine control facts whose ordinary transition changes project state
roles.DERIVED: rebuildable projection, index, summary or navigation representation that is not unique accepted truth

governing_statuses.EFFECT_WITHHELD: accepted/governing object whose effect is deliberately held for a scoped reason
governing_statuses.SUPERSEDED: replaced prospectively by a successor while retained historically
governing_statuses.RETIRED: no longer operationally applicable and not superseded by a semantically equivalent successor

unit_rule: Use the whole carrier if homogeneous. Split only into stable, consequential semantic units with durable anchors when different roles/statuses would otherwise be conflated. Do not split merely to make the model pass.
